responsibility: Defines the Rust HIR class hierarchy for generic parameters. It introduces the abstract `GenericParam` interface and concrete nodes for lifetime parameters and const generic parameters, with storage for outer attributes, bounds, default type or expression payloads, source locations, and `Analysis::NodeMapping`, plus cloning and visitor hooks. This file is the reusable generic-parameter model embedded by functions, traits, impls, and other item-level HIR declarations.
same_name_distinction: Declares the generic-parameter class hierarchy and data layout used across HIR, including the abstract `GenericParam` API and concrete lifetime and const parameter node types. Unlike `rust-hir-generic-param.cc`, it provides the type definitions and contracts rather than the out-of-line constructor, clone, and formatting implementations.
